note: How each market expects certain elements to be presented, for the market gap preview. Short paraphrases written by people, not by the AI, and not yet checked against the source texts. A clause_id must name a clause in the rule packs; an unknown id is ignored when the file is loaded. Use null when no rule-pack clause covers the element.

net_quantity.text: Dual units, US customary (oz, lb, fl oz) and metric, in the bottom 30% of the principal display panel

allergens.text: A 'Contains:' statement (or the names in the ingredient list) for the major food allergens, tree nuts named one by one

nutrition.text: Nutrition Facts panel per serving with % Daily Value, in the FDA format

language.text: An official language of every country where the pack is sold

net_quantity.text: Metric units only (g, kg, ml, l)

allergens.text: Allergens emphasised (for example in bold) within the ingredient list

nutrition.text: Nutrition declaration per 100 g or 100 ml, energy in kJ and kcal

net_quantity.text: Net quantity in metric units, with the manufacturer, packer or importer declarations

nutrition.text: Per 100 g or 100 ml (and per serve), energy in kcal

marks.text: Green dot (vegetarian) or brown triangle (non-vegetarian) mark
